reconstruction.text: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its induced norm and Borel sigma-algebra. Let gamma_E be the centered Gaussian probability measure on E with covariance the identity. Let L^2(gamma_E; R) be the real Hilbert space of square-integrable real-valued functions modulo gamma_E-almost-everywhere equality. Write H_j for the unnormalized probabilists' Hermite polynomial of degree j, with its integer coefficients interpreted in R (H_0(t)=1, H_1(t)=t, and H_(n+1)(t)=t H_n(t)-n H_(n-1)(t) for n>=1). This is a definition, parameterized by every j in N={0,1,2,...} and every w in E: Phi_j(w)=[x |-> H_j(<w,x>)] in L^2(gamma_E; R). Its body first maps the integer coefficients of H_j to R, then evaluates that real polynomial at <w,x>, and applies the square-integrability witness to form this exact function's L^2 class. Thus the defined family has type N -> E -> L^2(gamma_E; R); the body specifies the class, whereas the type alone would only specify a member of that Hilbert space.
